claim: There are dangling delegation record risks that Route 53 can't protect against. To protect yourself against them, make sure the parent NS records match the delegation set of the Route 53 hosted zone. Enabling DNSSEC signing for the hosted zone can serve as another layer of protection.

evidence.quote: However, there are other dangling delegation record risks, which Route 53 can't protect against, as detailed in scenarios 2 through 5 in the following examples. To protect yourself against this broader set of risks, make sure the parent NS records match the delegation set for the Route 53 hosted zone.
Additionally, enabling DNSSEC signing for a Route 53 hosted zone can serve as another layer of protection beyond the best practices mentioned above.
